catalogs.otoroshi.io.RemoteCatalog.description: A remote catalog: a source outside otoroshi (an http endpoint, a file, a git repository of github, gitlab, bitbucket, gitea, forgejo or codeberg, an s3 bucket, a consul kv store) holding entity definitions in json or yaml. Deploying the catalog reconciles otoroshi with the source: the entities it holds are created or updated, the ones it created before and that the source no longer holds are deleted. It is deployed through the api, on a schedule, or from a webhook

_loc.description: The tenant (organization) and the teams the remote catalog belongs to. The default tenant and team when absent

id.description: The unique id of the remote catalog, used to deploy it. The entities it creates carry it in their metadata, as `created_by: remote_catalog=<id>`

name.description: The display name of the remote catalog, shown and searched in the list of the remote catalogs of the backoffice

description.description: A free text describing the remote catalog, shown in its form of the backoffice. `--` when absent
description.example: The routes and backends of the infrastructure repository

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the remote catalog, with string values. The admin api stores the date of the last write of the entity under `created_at` or `updated_at`

tags.description: Free tags of the remote catalog, to sort and search the catalogs

enabled.description: Whether the remote catalog is deployed by its schedule and by the webhook plugin, true when absent. A disabled catalog can still be deployed through the api

source_kind.description: The kind of source the entities are fetched from, that tells how `source_config` is read: `http`, `file`, `github`, `gitlab`, `bitbucket` (bitbucket cloud), `bitbucketserver` (bitbucket server / data center), `gitea`, `forgejo`, `codeberg`, `git` (any git repository, cloned), `s3` or `consulkv`, or the kind of a source registered by an extension. `http` when absent

source_config.description: The configuration of the source, read according to `source_kind`: each kind reads the fields listed below that name it, and ignores the others. Free json object, empty when absent

url.description: `http`: the url of the document to fetch, that holds entities or is a catalog listing naming the documents to deploy (relative to the same url)

headers.description: `http`: the headers sent with the request, by name

timeout.description: `http`: the timeout of the request, in milliseconds, 30000 when absent

path.description: `file`: the path of the file or directory to read on the otoroshi host. Git sources: the path of the file or directory in the repository, the root of the repository when absent. A file can be a catalog listing that names the files to deploy

pre_command.description: `file`: a command run before the files are read (to pull a repository for instance), as the program followed by its arguments

items.description: The program or one of its arguments

repo.description: `github`, `gitlab`, `bitbucket`, `bitbucketserver`, `gitea`, `forgejo`, `codeberg`: the repository, as `owner/name`, or an organization, a group, a workspace or a project to scan all its repositories. `git`: the url of the repository to clone, over https or ssh

branch.description: Git sources: the branch to read, `main` when absent

token.description: Git sources: the token used to call the api of the forge, or added to the https url of a `git` repository. `consulkv`: the acl token

username.description: `bitbucket`, `bitbucketserver`, `git`: the user name that goes with the token

base_url.description: `github`, `gitlab`, `bitbucket`, `bitbucketserver`, `gitea`, `forgejo`, `codeberg`: the base url of the api of the forge, for a self hosted one. `https://api.github.com`, `https://gitlab.com`, `https://api.bitbucket.org`, `http://localhost:7990`, `http://localhost:3000` (gitea, forgejo) and `https://codeberg.org` when absent

repo_patterns.description: Git forges, when `repo` is an organization: the glob patterns of the names of the repositories to scan, all of them when absent

items.description: A glob pattern of repository names

ssh_private_key_path.description: `git`: the path of the private ssh key used to clone a repository over ssh

key.description: `s3`: the key of the object to read, that can be a catalog listing naming the objects to deploy

endpoint.description: `s3`: the url of the s3 endpoint, `https://s3.amazonaws.com` when absent. `consulkv`: the url of the consul http api, `http://localhost:8500` when absent

region.description: `s3`: the region of the bucket, `eu-west-1` when absent

prefix.description: `consulkv`: the key to read, or the prefix of the keys to read (the ones ending with `.json`, `.yaml` or `.yml`)

dc.description: `consulkv`: the datacenter to read from, the one of the agent when absent

scheduling.description: Deploys the remote catalog as a job of otoroshi: once, at a fixed interval or on a cron expression. Not scheduled when absent or invalid

test_deploy_args.description: The arguments given to the source when the catalog is deployed or tested from the backoffice. Free json object, empty when absent

example.name: Infrastructure catalog
example.description: The routes and backends of the infrastructure repository

RemoteCatalogScheduling.description: How a remote catalog is deployed as a job of otoroshi, and the arguments of each deployment. The job is scheduled as soon as the catalog is saved with `enabled` true (the catalog being enabled too), and stopped when it is disabled or deleted

enabled.description: Whether the remote catalog is deployed as a job, false when absent

kind.description: When the job runs: `ScheduledOnce` once after `initial_delay`, `ScheduledEvery` after `initial_delay` then every `interval`, `Cron` on `cron_expression`, `Autonomous` once after `initial_delay`. Read without case, an unknown value is read as `ScheduledEvery`, which is also the default

instantiation.description: Where the job runs in a cluster: `OneInstancePerOtoroshiInstance` on every instance, `OneInstancePerOtoroshiWorkerInstance` on every worker, `OneInstancePerOtoroshiLeaderInstance` on every leader, `OneInstancePerOtoroshiCluster` on a single instance of the cluster. Read without case, an unknown value is read as `OneInstancePerOtoroshiInstance`, which is also the default

initial_delay.description: The delay before the first deployment, in milliseconds. No delay when null

interval.description: The delay between two deployments of a `ScheduledEvery` job, in milliseconds. A `ScheduledEvery` job without interval only runs once

cron_expression.description: The quartz cron expression (seconds, minutes, hours, day of month, month, day of week) of a `Cron` job

deploy_args.description: The arguments given to the source on each scheduled deployment. Free json object, empty when absent
